summary: Hyperscale Data filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing at-the-market offering program, reducing the aggregate amount sellable under its June 18, 2026 sales agreement with Spartan Capital Securities from $300 million to $100 million. The company disclosed it has already sold 121,827,841 Class A common shares for roughly $49.8 million in gross proceeds. The filing, made under Items 1.01, 7.01, and 9.01, is a routine shelf takedown disclosure rather than a special situation. No board recommendation, premium, or negotiated deal terms are present. Overhang and share-count dilution remain the relevant considerations.
